parent_objective: audit one-seed public controller-family pilot before interpretation or scaling
blocked_by: M1674 one-seed result cannot be interpreted or scaled before audit

public_gates: M1675 must audit all M1674 required artifacts
M1675 must separate plumbing pass from architecture interpretation
M1675 must decide whether to repeat, scale, repair, or route to decisive task-source mapping
M1675 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repair the M1663 artifact

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the first one-seed public controller-family plumbing pilot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1674 artifacts are missing
stop if M1674 is interpreted as architecture ranking
stop if private holdout or promotion is admitted
stop if L2 current-tiled or L3 reset results are ignored
fallback_plan: route to runner repair if any profile failed
route to metric audit if non-finite metrics occurred
route to decisive task-source mapping if plumbing passed but standard layer remains non-decisive
route to three-seed standard repeat only if audit justifies it as necessary

admission_evidence: M1674 completed one public seed across all 12 profiles with finite metrics
allowed_updates: M1675 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits repeat, repair, or decisive task-source mapping
next_stage_criteria: M1674 result class and gates are explicit
L2 current-tiled and L3 reset implications are scoped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; audit must treat L2 current-tiled parity and L3 reset superiority as diagnostic, not proof.
history_necessity_tests: audit L2 normal versus current-tiled deltas
audit L3 online versus corrected reset-control deltas
do not claim history necessity from one standard-layer seed
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If current-tiled/reset controls remain strong, route to decisive task-source mapping or negative standard-layer story rather than weakening claim standards.
allowed_claims: one-seed public pilot result audit and route decision
no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1674 can be audited as a plumbing pass while keeping controller-family interpretation blocked.
success_criteria: audit records M1674 completion and finite metrics
audit reports L2 current-tiled and L3 reset comparisons
audit explicitly blocks architecture ranking and paper-level claims
audit chooses repeat, repair, decisive task-source mapping, or stop
failure_criteria: audit treats one-seed result as architecture ranking
audit routes directly to private holdout or promotion
decision_rule: M1675 passes if it audits M1674 and chooses a next route before any interpretation, repeat, decisive mapping, promotion, or private holdout.
